scope: Specification and source-audit data only. No engine state, reward evaluator, search or training is implemented here.

boundary.logical_controllers: Retain USSR for Mongolia and British Commonwealth for FEC diplomacy without adding outside territories, units, income or extra turns beyond the five projected national slots.

politics.alliance_labels: Scoring and decision routing do not declare war, incorporate minors, merge national accounts, permit joint attacks, or bypass the Chinese Truce.

starting_accounts.authority: User authorized theatre-adjusted starting treasury; exact capped-local-base formula is a documented scenario derivation, not an official alternate setup.
starting_accounts.formula: For independent national accounts: min(official starting IPP, retained directly possessed original land printed IPP). Controlled and unaligned minors start with zero treasury.
starting_accounts.income_not_cash: Cash adjustment is not a war declaration or a full-production flag. Current income is the legally collectable recurring rate, including reachable modifiers, not the sum of printed IPP of every controlled minor.
starting_accounts.fec_income_profile_proposal: Start the local rate at 2 and cap peacetime local production at retained eligible land income; keep global full-production and war-trigger concepts separate. Do not import the other 12 printed IPP or manufacture a Home Country supply path.

completed_price_basis.note: Keeps setup and free recruited units comparable; actual purchase discounts still change payments. User review needed before reward implementation.

wealth.free_capital_ship_repair: Deducts zero IPP under the literal formula; do not invent a damage discount.
wealth.negative_facility_value: Possible under literal formula: Major Factory price18 minus repair20 equals -2. Null minimum means no clamp, not zero.

standalone_city_asset_value.note: City is not a purchasable facility; count its current income and distinct facilities, not a second city-capital asset.

wealth.deduplication: One physical facility ID or undirected rail border is one asset. Never count both paid construction and its completed replacement.

cross_owner_rail_attribution.rule: Half of one undirected border asset to each endpoint possessor; same-alliance endpoints aggregate once. Uncontrolled minor shares count toward nobody. This is scoring only, not control or repair permission.

rule_reachability.reason: Audited Nagasaki Line is fully retained: Rehe-P14-P15-Kyushu, one shared 5-IPP loss cap. Tokyo Line crosses excluded P34 and terminates in excluded P50, so its fragments are omitted by closed-profile policy. Convoy metadata is audited here but canonical map projection and gameplay remain unimplemented.

Special placement can bypass factories in eligible Hong Kong; absence of Calcutta is not capture or surrender.
